svg.title: TC4 microstructure segmentation framework
svg.desc: Shared IWMID enhancement supplies normalized RGB to two separately trained models: a VGG16 residual U-Net and SegFormer-B0. Each predicts its own five-class map. A separate grayscale and Otsu branch returns an auxiliary binary prior. Insets reproduce panels a, c and d of manuscript Figure 6.
svg.text: The same RGB input; each model learns its own parameters
Five encoder stages · residual decoder · skip connections
Hierarchical MiT-B0 encoder · multi-scale MLP decoding
Micrograph and prediction insets: manuscript Fig. 6 (a, c, d). Network blocks are schematic.
